d: Pet Point is one of Kuwait's leading pet supplies companies, operating retail shops, a central warehouse, an in-house delivery fleet, an e-commerce platform, wholesale distribution to co-operatives and key accounts, a call centre, and grooming services.

This is a company-wide role reporting directly to the General Manager. The role leads the business through its department heads – Sales & Retail, Purchasing, Warehouse & Inventory, Logistics & Delivery, E-commerce, Customer Service, Marketing, Finance, HR and IT/ERP. The person will not do each department's work; they will set priorities, hold department heads accountable, and make sure the whole company executes as one chain.
Direct and follow up with all department heads; set priorities, approve action plans and hold each head accountable for results and deadlines.
Own company problems end to end: identify the responsible department, drive root-cause analysis, agree the corrective action, owner and deadline, and follow up until the issue is verified and closed.
Keep the full chain working together – marketing campaigns, stock availability, purchasing, warehouse, e-commerce and delivery – so that plans in one department are supported by the others.
Translate company objectives into quarterly plans for each department, with clear KPIs, owners and timelines, and track progress weekly and monthly.
Run a central action tracker for all management decisions, with an owner, deadline and status for every action.
Deliver weekly and monthly management reports covering progress against plan, overdue actions, key problems, KPIs, risks and decisions needed.
Request information, action plans and deadlines from any department, while department heads remain accountable for their specialist work.
Drive process improvement, SOPs and better use of the company ERP, data and AI tools across all departments.
3–5 years of operations experience in retail, e-commerce or distribution (not only sales, customer service, admin or a single function).
Has personally coordinated several departments at the same time – such as retail stores, warehouse, delivery/drivers, e-commerce and purchasing – and followed actions through to closure.
Has tracked KPIs and prepared weekly/monthly management reports for senior management or owners.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain or a related field.
Currently based in Kuwait with transferable residency (Article 18), within commutable distance of Al Rai, Farwaniya.
Daily use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) to build reports, analyse data, draft SOPs and automate repetitive work.
Experience managing or overseeing retail stores/branches.
Inventory control: stock counts, reconciliation, reorder levels and expiry management.
Experience supervising delivery drivers, warehouse staff or a fleet.
Hands-on ERP experience (e.g. Odoo, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle).
Basic accounting knowledge: budgets, P&L, invoices and cost control.
Experience with sales targets and sales performance analysis.
Data analysis: Excel / Google Sheets reports, pivot tables and dashboards.
Working knowledge of digital marketing, HR and legal basics.
Experience in pet, FMCG or retail consumer products.
Fluent English; Arabic is an advantage.
Please send your CV with a short note explaining (1) which departments you have coordinated at the same time, and (2) how you use AI tools in your daily work.
Please note: this role coordinates and holds department heads accountable across the whole company. Applications without cross-department coordination experience will not be considered.

d: The Store Director is responsible for overseeing all aspects of store operations, ensuring the smooth and profitable functioning of the department store. This role entails leading the team to achieve financial and operational targets, providing excellent customer service, optimizing stock management, and maintaining a high standard of visual merchandising. The Store Director plays a key role in driving the store's strategic initiatives while fostering a positive and motivating work environment.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

Proven track record of managing a large-scale, multi-brand retail operation or department store.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving profitability.
Excellent understanding of retail operations, including inventory management, visual merchandising, and customer service.
